The lighting on the airship (brightly lit from top-left) does not perfectly match the lighting on the foreground building (which appears flatter/darker). The airship also lacks atmospheric haze appropriate for its apparent distance relative to the sharpness of the clouds behind it.

custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the 'smoothness' of the airship. Real airships have visible seams, panels, or fabric textures. If the classifier confirms 'airship' but the perceptual auditor notes a complete lack of high-frequency detail on the hull, this is a strong indicator of AI generation. Also, check if the shadow cast by the airship (if any) aligns with the sun direction implied by the building.
